mapper.select: select b.id as id, b.status as bookingStatus, p.id as propertyId, p.title as roomTitle, p.description as description, p.room_count as roomCount, p.rent_price as rentPrice, p.is_available as isAvailable, p.address as address, pi.id as imageId, pi.image_url as image_url, pa.amenity as amenity_amenities, u.id as renterId, u.full_name as renterFullName, u.email as renterEmail, u.phone_number as renterPhone from booking b left join property p on b.property_id = p.id left join property_image pi on p.id = pi.property_id left join property_amenities pa on p.id = pa.property_id left join users u on b.renter_id = u.id where b.id = #{bookingId}
